sloka: सा बभूव मुहूर्तेन हरिभिर्दीपिता पुरी।लोकस्यास्य क्षये घोरे प्रदीप्तेव वसुन्धरा ।। ६.७५.२९ ।।
transliteration: sā babhūva muhūrtena haribhirdīpitā purī।lokasyāsya kṣaye ghore pradīpteva vasundharā ।। 6.75.29 ।।

translations.english: Some horses that were released, went in different directions afraid of elephants. Some elephants seeing horses ran away in fear.
